title: Juicy, Winey Thai Cabbage Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy Thai dish featuring winey flavors and juicy cabbage, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This recipe features a diabetic-friendly twist using sugar-free fish sauce.

ingredients.name: Pork belly
ingredients.notes: You can also use chicken or tofu for a vegetarian option

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.notes: Choose a variety with thick, crunchy leaves

ingredients.name: Sugar-free fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork belly and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage and cook until slightly softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the sugar-free fish sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the cabbage mixture over a bed of rice or noodles, garnished with cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
